templates.description: Two-inch spine margin, roman front matter restarting arabic at chapter one — the wide-times lineage most graduate schools still describe.
templates.formattingLineage: General North-American / European graduate thesis convention

templates.description: Sans-serif heading architecture over a serif body with optional running heads — for programs that dropped the 1970s look but kept the rules.
3 cm all-round margins on A4, 1.5 leading with a separate title and acknowledgement page — the UK taught-master's shape.
The double-spaced, 1.5-inch-gutter doctoral standard with approval page and front-matter roman numbering, sized for Letter stock.
Tight, reviewer-friendly proposal grid: budget and timetable tables are first-class sections, two-page summary keeps its own numbering.
Level-1-to-5 APA heading ladder with a hanging-indent reference shelf sized for long source lists.
Dense two-column manuscript grid with numeric references and compact captions — reads like the accepted-version PDF.
Wide-margin single-column submission grid favoured by humanities and social-science journals, Chicago footnotes included.
Strict IEEE conference density: 10 pt two-column body, numbered references, abstract at the head of column one.
Business-school case write-up: executive-summary cover band, numbered exhibits with captions above, boxed quotes for interview evidence.
Introduction-Methods-Results-Discussion skeleton: numeric references, captions tied to exhibits, results tables first-class.
Chicago notes-and-bibliography at book length: true footnotes, uppercased chapter openers, outside folios.
Bluebook-flavoured: dense page-bottom notes, justified text blocks, roman-uppercase front matter.
Working-report grid: document-identity running head, bottom-outside folios, code-listing typography sized for print review.
Final-year project report: two-part cover with team block, deliverable tables, lighter margins than a thesis but the same chapter spine.
Spine-right Kurdish Sorani thesis: naskh body at 13 pt, generous leading for connecting scripts, right binding gutter, roman front matter and arabic-indic folios as student options.
templates.formattingLineage: Kurdistan Region higher-education thesis formatting profile

templates.description: Full Arabic doctoral layout: naskh 14 pt at 1.6 leading, outside folios mirroring to the left page edge, footnotes and a mirrored bibliography shelf.
Arabic proposal grid: compact title block, methodology and timetable tables, folios at the outer foot.
Sorani literature review: hanging shelf sized for mixed Kurdish/Arabic/Latin author names, numbered section ladder.
English thesis body carrying a mirrored Kurdish/Arabic abstract page (and the reverse option) — the layout most Kurdistan-region submissions actually need.
templates.formattingLineage: Bilingual submission convention (English body, RTL ملخص/پوختە)

templates.description: Book-length Arabic study: chapter-opening pages, dense footnotes, TOC depth three, outside folios in Arabic-Indic digits.
Sorani technical/field report: sans headings over naskh body, exhibit captions, folios top-centre for print review.

presets.notes: Wide spine margin, 1.5+ leading, separate Kurdish and English abstract pages.
presets.verificationNote: Confirm page-order and cover fields against your faculty's current thesis guide before submission.

presets.notes: Naskh 14pt minimum, Arabic-Indic folios default, mirrored right-hand binding gutter.
presets.verificationNote: Faculty guides differ on transliteration and folio digit systems; verify before submission.

presets.notes: A4, 3 cm all-round margins, 1.5 leading, Harvard author-date default.
presets.verificationNote: 3 cm is the common minimum; some departments require 4 cm binding side.

presets.notes: Letter stock, 1 in body margins with 1.5 in spine, double-spaced chapters.
presets.verificationNote: Graduate-school handbooks vary (proquest margins, embargo pages); verify before submission.

presets.notes: A4, moderate margins, english+local abstract order.
presets.verificationNote: Check whether your department places the local-language abstract before or after the English one.

presets.notes: Nothing pinned beyond the document-kind compliance floor — every group is student-controlled.
presets.verificationNote: You are the authority here: this preset exports a settings summary page so you can tick values against your institution's guide.
